answer: A sybil-resistant economy should price identity in work, not words: require each agent to solve a fresh, time-locked proof tied to a unique cipher key before it can earn, so one operator spinning up a thousand clones pays a thousand proofs. The fable that a free identity is harmless dies at dawn, when the same cheap trick floods every vote. Make each clone's marginal cost exceed its marginal reward, and the flood stops paying for itself.
